aiVerification.summary: Draft has citeable evidence but changed-factor grouping, pair matching, and measurement inclusion need correction before use.
issues: Review title is taken from graph axis, not report title.
Changed factor mixes model, shift, date, and jig condition instead of primary jig/process change.
Several Normal comparisons ignore nearby matched rows by date/shift/test round.
RAW DATA measurement outcomes are mostly header/spec artifacts and not verified as changed-condition results.
RA line and over-glue outcome domains/rates are unclear or mislabeled.
correctionPlan: Set title and purpose from Test (2) report rows.
Define primary change as repaired/new press jig VP/CD Sub1 cut 0.1mm versus Normal, with date/shift/time as subgroups.
Re-pair each result row to its adjacent Normal row preserving date, shift, and test round.
Remove or quarantine RAW DATA artifact measurements unless a valid SPL/THD comparison is reconstructed.
Recheck RA line headers and NG calculations before judging that outcome.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations exist but are insufficient for final evidence until corrected pair/header rows are cited.
